items.title: AppLovin Stock Rockets 23% After Hours as CEO Calls Last Quarter’s Miss ‘Our Own Foot Fault’
items.summary: View more earnings on APP On Wednesday, AppLovin Corp. (NASDAQ:APP) CEO Adam Foroughi pushed back against concerns about intensifying competition in the advertising technology market. He said the company’s previous-quarter shortcomings were largely self-inflicted. AppLovin shares gained 10.69% during Wednesday’s regular trading session, closing at $271.75. items.title: AppLovin (NASDAQ:APP) delivers strong Q3 2026 numbers, stock jumps 24.9%
items.summary: Mobile app technology company AppLovin (NASDAQ:APP) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with revenue up 55.5% year on year to $2.18 billion. In addition, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($2.38 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly strong and 5.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its GAAP profit of $4.30 per share was 6.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
